title: 銀河の塵と、忘れられた星図の残響
author: 鏡 ミライ

en.title: Galactic Dust and the Echoes of Forgotten Star Charts
en.premise: In an era where the 'Reminiscence Market'—a place where digitized fragments of memory are bought and sold—has bleached the colors from human emotion, a young man who restores ancient star charts discovers a 'memory of a beautiful sunset' that belongs to no one. As he traces the origins of this memory, he realizes that the lost star charts record the 'inconvenient yet precious moments' humanity once cherished. In a world of excessive convenience, a journey begins to fill the void left in the human heart.

zh.title: 银河之尘与被遗忘的星图残响
zh.premise: 在那个将记忆碎片数据化并进行买卖的『追忆市场』使人们的情感色彩变得淡薄的时代。一名修复古老星图的青年，某天在市场的角落里，拾到了一段本不属于任何人的『美丽黄昏的记忆』。在追寻这段记忆的过程中，他意识到那些本应失传的古老星图，记录着人类曾经拥有的『不便却可爱的时光』。在这个过于便利的世界中，一场为了填补被削减掉的心灵空白的旅程就此展开。
